5 Acres for Sale in Salado, TX #landforsale 

Prime 5-Acre Lot in Upscale Salado, TX – A Rare Opportunity!

Discover the perfect canvas for your dream home in the prestigious community of Salado, TX! This stunning 5-acre lot offers a picturesque setting with mature trees and a seasonal creek at the back, creating a peaceful retreat with nature at your doorstep.

Key Highlights:
Highly Sought-After Location – Nestled in Salado ISD, offering top-rated schools and a welcoming community.
Prime Accessibility – Less than an hour to Austin and minutes from downtown Salado’s charming shops and restaurants.
Exclusive Amenities – Enjoy access to a community greenbelt with Salado Creek frontage, a private pavilion for gatherings, and tennis courts.
Build-Ready – Ample space to design your ideal custom home in a serene, upscale setting.

This is a rare opportunity to own acreage in one of Central Texas’s most desirable areas. Don’t miss your chance—call today to schedule a tour and start planning your future!
